card.name: Inside capitalized warning words
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle piece of long words in all-caps headings, most often the O in EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY in boxed warnings. Also seen in other all-caps words split in two.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O ending EMBRY in the all-caps boxed warning title EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.
modes.example: WARNING: CARDIOMYOPATHY, INFUSION REACTIONS, EMBRY<<O>>-FETAL TOXICITY,
